visdrone_reference_python.protocol: Python reproduction of public MATLAB toolkit conventions; NOT MATLAB cross-validated
visdrone_reference_python.conventions: Category-0 union raster filtering, MATLAB rounding and integral indexing; score=0 GT ignored in matching; per-image global top-k before category filtering; continuous VOC precision envelope. Category11 is outside evaluated classes, not a category0 region. Toolkit repeated-class aggregation and GT denominator reproduced literally; macro aggregate also given. APsmall is not defined by this toolkit.
